post.description: Creates a new user account with default USER role. Strips client-supplied roles to prevent privilege escalation. Enforces registration rate limiting.
Authenticates user credentials with Argon2 password verification and issues a signed JWT Bearer token. Enforces login rate limiting.

get.description: Retrieves profile and role information for the currently authenticated user.
Calculates and returns user coding statistics including total problems solved by difficulty, total submissions by verdict, and acceptance rate.

get.summary: Get problems solved by authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves the list of active problems for which the authenticated user has at least one ACCEPTED submission.

get.summary: Get authenticated user submission activity calendar
get.description: Returns daily submission activity counts for the authenticated user across a specified time range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time range for activity aggregation ('30d', '90d', '1y', 'all'). Defaults to '1y'.

get.description: Public endpoint to retrieve active problems with summary projections, test case counts, readiness breakdowns, pagination, and derived solved status for authenticated users.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of problems per page (1 to 100)

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter by single topic tag (alias for tags)

post.description: Creates a new problem. Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

get.description: Public endpoint to retrieve complete specification and examples for an active problem.

patch.description: Partially updates an existing problem. Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

parameters.name: problemId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the problem to update

delete.description: Soft-deactivates an existing problem (`isActive: false`). Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

parameters.name: problemId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the problem to deactivate

get.summary: Get test cases for a problem
get.description: Retrieves test cases for a problem with database-level role isolation. Normal users (USER role) receive ONLY active PUBLIC test cases. Administrators (ADMIN role) receive all test cases (both PUBLIC and HIDDEN).

200.description: Accessible test cases for the problem

post.summary: Create a test case for a problem
post.description: Creates a new test case associated with the problem specified in the path. Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

get.description: Retrieves a single test case. Administrators can retrieve any test case. Normal users can only retrieve if the test case is active and visibility is PUBLIC (otherwise returns 404).

parameters.name: testCaseId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the test case

patch.description: Partially updates an existing test case. Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

parameters.name: testCaseId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the test case to update

delete.description: Soft-deactivates an existing test case (`isActive: false`). Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role). Records administrative audit log.

parameters.name: testCaseId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the test case to deactivate

post.description: Validates submission, persists initial record, and enqueues execution job into Redis/BullMQ for asynchronous processing by dedicated workers. Returns immediately with QUEUED status and PENDING verdict. Fails fast with 422 if problem has zero active test cases. Enforces submission rate limits.

201.description: Submission created and successfully queued for asynchronous processing

get.description: Retrieves submissions belonging strictly to the authenticated user. Omits heavy sourceCode by default for performance unless `includeCode=true` is requested. Supports filtering by problemId, language, and verdict.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of submissions per page (1 to 100)

parameters.name: includeCode
parameters.description: Include sourceCode field in submission objects (default false)

get.description: Retrieves current or final submission details including execution status (PENDING, QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED), evaluation metrics, and full submitted source code. Used by clients to poll for final execution results after creating an asynchronous submission. Enforces object-level authorization: accessible only to the submission owner or administrators (ADMIN role).

200.description: Submission details with source code and evaluation metrics

get.description: Retrieves audit trails for administrative problem and test-case mutations. Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of logs per page (1 to 100)

get.description: Retrieves BullMQ queue operational metrics (waiting, active, completed, failed, delayed counts). Restricted strictly to administrators (ADMIN role).
Quick operational probe verifying Express process responsiveness and database connectivity state.

200.description: Process is live and database is connected

get.description: Deep operational probe validating MongoDB connectivity and Docker execution engine runtime availability.

200.description: System ready to handle traffic and code execution

503.description: One or more core dependencies are unhealthy

get.description: Renders the interactive Swagger UI interface loaded with the local OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification.
Returns the machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification JSON.
